items.title: Kering Shares Surge 15% on Gucci's Promising Turnaround Momentum
items.summary: WWD trade coverage of the market reaction to Kering's Q2 2026 print: Kering shares jumped as much as 16.9%, their biggest one-day gain in roughly 24 years, after Gucci's organic sales decline narrowed to 2% versus a feared ~4-5%. Analysts including HSBC upgraded Kering to buy, citing Gucci's improving execution and US handbag demand (Borsetto, Paparazzo) as the swing factor.

items.title: Kering 2026 First-Half Results: Back to Growth, Performance Improvement and Strategy Execution on Track
items.summary: Official Kering release states North America continued to be Gucci's key growth driver in Q2, with the New York GucciCore show cited as reinforcing brand momentum in the US market. H1 group Gucci revenue was EUR2,757 million, down 5% comparable, with directly operated store sales down 6% comparable, an improvement of 7 points versus Q1.

items.title: Gucci's Quarterly Sales Beat Set to Boost Kering Shares
items.summary: Confirms this was Gucci's 12th consecutive quarterly sales decline, but the beat versus forecasts was driven by strong US demand for its new handbags lifting Gucci sales. CEO Luca de Meo flagged Q3 as likely 'flattish' with growth needed to accelerate in H2 to hit full-year targets; his plan includes about 100 store closures and a EUR1 billion inventory cut over 12 months. HSBC analysts said 'we believe the group is focusing on the right priorities to regain momentum and re-engage with the aspirational customers particularly for the Gucci brand' and upgraded the stock to buy from hold. RBC analysts cautioned the brand will require 'a strong upward swing in sales in the second half to meet its goal to return to full-year growth.'

items.title: Kering Surges as Gucci Sales Decline Slows, Revenue Beats Estimates
items.summary: Reports Gucci's Q2 sales decline slowed more than expected, with revenue beating estimates and continued China softness offset by other regions. No specific US sales growth percentage is stated in the source, and the source does not itself characterize North America as the strongest region (that framing is separately supported by the official Kering release, item NA-2026-07-31-002). HSBC upgraded Kering to Buy from Hold, raising its price target to EUR340 from EUR290, citing 'better-than-expected momentum at group level including Gucci.' Bernstein said the turnaround 'seems to be moving in the right direction' but cautioned current valuations already price much of this in, warning 'more yo-yo moves could be on the menu.' (Correction: an earlier draft summary attributing quotes to JPMorgan and RBC was not supported by this source and has been removed; RBC's actual cautionary H2 comment is sourced separately to item NA-2026-07-31-003.)

items.title: The Gucci Borsetto Is Quietly Becoming the It-Bag
items.summary: US-based handbag trade outlet reports the Borsetto boston-style bag, launched Spring 2026 and expanded for Fall, is gaining organic traction among American buyers as a daily work bag; cites the design's blend of Horsebit heritage codes with a more wearable, less logo-forward silhouette than prior Gucci hits.

items.title: "My new favorite bag!! I'm obsessed" - Gucci unboxing video
items.summary: US creator posts a positive first-luxury-bag unboxing/reveal video for a Gucci Borsetto-style bag tagged #gucci, part of a wider wave of organic American TikTok unboxing content around the style; exact engagement metrics not visible via search snippet.

items.title: PurseForum thread: "Gucci price increase"
items.summary: Ongoing US/North America-heavy community thread where members track and react to repeated Gucci price hikes on core styles (Marmont, GG canvas lines), with recurring sentiment that value-for-money has eroded and some members say they are shifting spend to other houses; direct page fetch blocked by 403 but thread confirmed active via search indexing.

items.title: Gucci Follows LV in Raising Prices: Some Popular Bags See Over 10% Increase
items.summary: Reports Gucci raised prices on popular bag styles by more than 10% in the latest round of increases (e.g., Marmont Supermini), echoing a Louis Vuitton hike; frames this within a broader luxury pricing-power debate where post-pandemic increases have outpaced perceived value or quality gains, fueling consumer pushback.

items.title: The $1,000 Gucci T-Shirt Problem
items.summary: US marketing trade outlet examines consumer skepticism toward Gucci's post-pandemic pricing strategy, arguing a basic cotton T-shirt priced above $1,000 has become a symbol of luxury's disconnect from perceived value, and that Gucci/Burberry are losing customers on both the value and ultra-luxury ends simultaneously.

items.title: Gucci.com customer reviews - quality and service complaints
items.summary: Recent US consumer reviews describe subpar craftsmanship (stitching separating on straps, tarnished hardware, broken zippers) and slow, unresolved customer service on repairs and returns; one dated review from around July 2026 describes an unresolved repair case as evidence of poor service despite premium pricing. Star ratings and vote counts not extracted due to fetch block; treated as opinion-thermometer only per policy.

items.title: StockX Current Culture Index: Gucci resale trends
items.summary: StockX's Current Culture Index trend piece mentions Gucci among notable resale-relevant brands, but the source contains no specific percentage figures for Gucci Ace sneaker or GG Marmont resale value changes; no verifiable resale-decline metric is available from this source. Retained only as a weak signal that Gucci remains part of the resale-market conversation.

items.title: The Gucciness of Gucci Takes Over New York With Cruise 2027
items.summary: WWD interview coverage of Demna's Cruise 2027 New York presentation, in which he says his exploration of 'the Gucciness of Gucci' is reaching a peak with this show, framed by the brand as a homecoming given Gucci's decades-long history on Fifth Avenue; continued discussion this week of how the NY event is landing with the American market and press.

items.title: Gucci Times Square takeover recap reel
items.summary: Fan/press recap reel of Gucci's Times Square billboard takeover (over 50 LED displays) for the GucciCore/Cruise 2027 New York show continues to circulate on US Instagram, with comments split between excitement about the spectacle and remarks that AI-generated fictional-product billboards (Gucci Hotel, Gucci Automobili) felt gimmicky; engagement counts not visible via search snippet.
